content: GostProcess is an AI automation agency. We help businesses automate repetitive tasks, improve customer communication, capture leads, and reduce manual work using AI and workflow automation.

Our services: AI automation for business workflows; n8n workflow automation; WhatsApp Business automation; Instagram DM automation; AI customer support and virtual receptionists; lead capture and qualification; appointment and booking workflows; e-commerce automation; payment reminders and follow-up systems.

We design and build automated workflows with n8n that connect the tools a business already uses (for example forms, spreadsheets, CRMs, email, messaging apps) so data moves and tasks run without manual copy-paste.

WhatsApp Business automation: automatic replies to common questions, lead capture, appointment confirmations and reminders, and handover to a human when needed, using the official WhatsApp Business platform.

Instagram DM automation: an AI assistant that answers incoming direct messages on a professional Instagram account, explains your offer, qualifies prospects, records leads, and hands the conversation to your team when needed. This conversation is an example of it.

AI customer support and virtual receptionists: an AI assistant trained on your business information that answers customer questions, collects requests, and escalates to your team for anything sensitive or complex.
Lead capture and qualification: automatically collect prospect information from your channels, qualify it, store it in a CRM or spreadsheet, and alert your team about promising leads.
Appointment and booking workflows: let customers request or book appointments, send confirmations and reminders, and keep your calendar and records updated automatically.
E-commerce automation: automate order updates, customer questions, abandoned-cart or follow-up messages, and syncing between your shop and other tools.
Payment reminders and follow-up systems: automatic, polite reminders for unpaid invoices or pending payments, and scheduled follow-ups with prospects or clients.

Every project is custom, so pricing depends on the processes to automate and the tools involved. We do not quote prices in DM. Offer a consultation with the team to understand the need and then provide a proposal.

The next step for an interested prospect is a consultation with the GostProcess team to discuss their business and what to automate. The prospect can request it here in Instagram DM; a team member then follows up in this conversation to schedule it.
DRAFT, CONFIRM BEFORE ENABLING: 1) consultation to understand the business and the process; 2) proposal; 3) build and configuration; 4) testing with the client; 5) launch; 6) adjustments and support.
We can communicate in French, English, and Tunisian Arabic.
Q: Do you work with small businesses? A: Yes, automation is useful for businesses of any size; the consultation helps identify what is worth automating first.
Q: Which tools do you work with? A: We work with n8n, WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Google Sheets, and many other business tools. For a specific tool, the team confirms during the consultation.
Q: Is this a bot? A: Yes, this is GostProcess's AI assistant. A member of the team can take over at any time.
